cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)
project("whisper_android")

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

# 1. Include paths for compiling the whisper_jni target
include_directories(
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ggml/include
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ggml/src
)

# 2a. GPU: ggml's OpenCL backend, with the Adreno-tuned matmul kernels.
# There is no NDK OpenCL library to link, and a hard link dependency would
# stop libwhisper_jni.so loading on phones without OpenCL. ggml-opencl links
# a shim instead (opencl_shim.cpp, generated by tools/gen_opencl_shim.py)
# that dlopens the vendor libOpenCL.so at first use; where that fails, ggml
# registers no OpenCL device and whisper.cpp runs on the CPU.
set(GGML_OPENCL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_OPENCL_EMBED_KERNELS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_OPENCL_USE_ADRENO_KERNELS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_library(subly_opencl_shim STATIC opencl_shim.cpp)
target_include_directories(subly_opencl_shim PUBLIC
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/OpenCL-Headers)
set_target_properties(subly_opencl_shim PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_link_libraries(subly_opencl_shim PRIVATE dl)

# Satisfy ggml-opencl's find_package(OpenCL) with the headers and the shim
# target; target_link_libraries accepts a target name here.
set(OpenCL_INCLUDE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/OpenCL-Headers CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(OpenCL_LIBRARY subly_opencl_shim CACHE STRING "" FORCE)

# 2b. Build the 'ggml' target via its official subdirectory.
add_subdirectory(ggml)

# Keep the shim's cl* forwarders internal to libggml-opencl.so, so they can
# never interpose on the vendor driver's own calls to those entry points.
if (TARGET ggml-opencl)
    target_link_options(ggml-opencl PRIVATE "-Wl,--exclude-libs,libsubly_opencl_shim.a")
endif ()

# 3. Build your Kotlin JNI bridge and the core whisper logic.
add_library(
        whisper_jni
        SHARED
        whisper-jni.cpp
        whisper.cpp
)

# 4. Apply required macro definitions
target_compile_definitions(whisper_jni PUBLIC GGML_USE_CPU)
target_compile_definitions(whisper_jni PRIVATE WHISPER_VERSION="unknown")

# 5. HARDWARE ACCELERATION INJECTION
# This explicitly forces NEON and FP16 on both your library AND the underlying ggml library.
if (${ANDROID_ABI} STREQUAL "arm64-v8a")
    # Apply to your JNI code
    target_compile_options(whisper_jni PRIVATE -march=armv8.2-a+fp16)

    # CRITICAL FIX: Force hardware acceleration into the separately compiled ggml targets!
    if (TARGET ggml)
        target_compile_options(ggml PRIVATE -march=armv8.2-a+fp16)
        target_compile_definitions(ggml PRIVATE GGML_USE_NEON)
    endif()
endif ()

# 6. Heavy optimizations for non-debug/Release builds
if (NOT ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE} STREQUAL "Debug")
    set(RELEASE_OPTS
            -O3
            -fvisibility=hidden
            -fvisibility-inlines-hidden
            -ffunction-sections
            -fdata-sections
    )
    target_compile_options(whisper_jni PRIVATE ${RELEASE_OPTS})
    if (TARGET ggml)
        target_compile_options(ggml PRIVATE ${RELEASE_OPTS})
    endif()

    target_link_options(whisper_jni PRIVATE -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL -flto)
endif ()

# 7. Find Android Logging library
find_library(log-lib log)

# 8. Link everything together
target_link_libraries(
        whisper_jni
        ggml
        ${log-lib}
)
